name: Five Seconds
hint: Two takes. TAKE 1: from spawn walk LEFT along the deck (top y=13) and step off its edge at x=12. You fall 7 units into the shaft (floor top y=20), land near x=8, walk left to switch s1 at x=3.2 and interact. You are now stranded — the shaft wall is 7 units and a jump tops out at 3.67 (5.6 even with jump held), and there is nothing to climb, so nobody who throws that switch ever leaves. End the take there. TAKE 2: your Echo repeats the drop and flips s1 at about t=1.6s, opening the door at x=31.5 for 5 seconds. Sprint RIGHT from spawn the instant the take starts: 16.7 units from x=16 to clear of the doorway at x=32.7, which is 1.82s at 9.2 u/s — inside the 5s hold with about 3.2s spare even before counting the head start you get while the Echo is still falling. Jump the 4.0-unit deck gap at x=25.5..29.5 on the way (it maintains your run speed), then walk into the exit at x=36.4. The bulkhead above the door runs to the top of the world; the doorway is the only breach.

dialogue.text: Sector two. The shaft below never had a ladder.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Whoever throws that switch stays down there. Five seconds of open door is what it buys.
Spend the take. Then run, and don't look into the shaft on the way past.
